title: When AI Can Build It, What Should We Assess? Rethinking Evidence of Engineering Competence
abstract: arXiv:2610.36413v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI can produce code, tests, documentation, and technical explanations that resemble artefacts traditionally used as evidence of student competence, weakening the inference from artefact quality to the engineering capability behind it. We report the redesign and first deployment of a 13-week, AI-permissive, software-intensive engineering course in which students may delegate substantial work to AI while retaining responsibility for planning, verification, review, integration, and explanation. The redesign couples an engineering accountability workflow, which structures human-AI work and preserves human decision authority, with an assessment evidence architecture comprising six complementary channels: product, process/origin, verification, explanation, reflection, and individual assurance. translated_title: 当AI能够构建时，我们该评估什么？重新思考工程能力的证据
translated_abstract: 生成式AI能够产生代码、测试、文档和技术解释，这些产物与传统上用作学生能力证据的成果极为相似，从而削弱了从产物质量推断其背后工程能力的可靠性。本文报告了一门为期13周、允许使用AI的软件密集型工程课程的重设计与首次部署，在该课程中学生可以将大量工作委托给AI，同时保留对规划、验证、评审、集成和解释的责任。该重设计将一个工程问责工作流（用于规范人机协作分工并保留人类的决策权威）与一个评估证据架构相结合，该架构包含六个互补渠道：产品、过程/来源、验证、解释、反思和个人保证。一个“收集—交叉核验—升级”（CCE）推理逻辑将这些渠道连接起来，而不是将任何单一产物或痕迹视为充分的证据。
tldr: 该论文在生成式AI时代重新设计了软件工程课程的评估体系，通过工程问责工作流和由“收集—交叉核验—升级”逻辑连接的六渠道证据架构（产品、过程/来源、验证、解释、反思、个人保证），在学生可将工作委托给AI的情况下仍能可靠评估其真实工程能力。
en_tdlr: This paper redesigns assessment in an AI-permissive software engineering course through an engineering accountability workflow and a six-channel evidence architecture (product, process/origin, verification, explanation, reflection, and individual assurance) connected by a collect-cross-check-escalate (CCE) reasoning logic, enabling reliable inference of genuine engineering competence even when students can delegate substantial work to AI.
